instruction: Right now you're facing towards a mirror. Now slightly turn left and move a bit forward, there is an open door to your right. Now slightly turn right and exit the room. You can see an open door in front of you, move towards the door and turn left. You can see an arch in front of you, move towards the arch and enter in to the room. Now slightly turn right, there is a fireplace in front of you, move towards the fireplace and turn right. You can see an open entrance in front of you, move towards the entrance and stand in front of it and it is your end point.
